text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: After clashing with an unbelieveablelineup of rivals, I come out the grandvictooor! Afterward, I'm surroundedby a group of stirred-up local Umas...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm wondering what I could have<n>done to upset
everyone when the<n>group of heroines starts battling
for<n>my affection. Could this be... an Uma<n>harem?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: They're so charming and pure, myheart won't make it! Oh, my preciousMorioka Umas! Anything for you,mile-ladies!
